rawContent: H.E.R. evokes Billie Holiday's performance of the anti-lynching song #strangefruit with the lyrics: “That kind of uncomfortable conversation is too hard for your trust-fund pockets to swallow/ To swallow the strange fruit hanging from my family tree.” #blacklivesmatter

Our hearts are w/ the family & loved ones of Daunte Wright, a 20-year old Black man & father who was shot & killed by police in MN during a traffic stop. We stand w/ protestors seeking justice & an end to all racist police brutality. #BlackLivesMatter   https://t.co/Arfp2OKe0U

No more #strangefruit.  
 
RIP #GeorgeFloyd, #MaKhaiBryant, #DaunteWright, #AdamToledo, & so many others. #BlackLivesMatter
